title: Coherent inverse-image comparisons for the common coefficient encoding
statement: For a finite discrete commutative ring B and the equivalences E_T of [def-weil-pbc-common-finite-discrete-encoding], the realization functors F_T admit natural inverse-image isomorphisms for every scheme morphism. The same family satisfies the composition-square equation for every CommSq, with the canonical derived composition and equality-transport isomorphisms. No direct-image or mate invertibility is asserted.

source.place: Lemma 5.4.1, with the sectionwise coefficient equivalence; Proposition 5.3.2

proof.text: Conjugate the canonical restriction identity for the etale/pro-etale site inclusion. Transport through the common sectionwise G and the ring isomorphisms pulled back from the one fixed profinite point. Naturality of constant-sheaf pullback identifies scalar restrictions.

Apply the exact functors termwise and localize. Identify the exact internal inverse image with its left derived functor. The equality of restriction composites for sq.w is preserved by conjugation, exact derivation and inclusion of D+; this yields the displayed square identity.
